Chapter 250. Ziffle and Kinzelo (4)
This is the last world.
Every time Orgal recalled what Helluram had said, it felt like his head was going to burst. H
e had developed a habit of unwittingly pulling his hair. Bishukel watched Orgal grabbing handfuls of hair whenever he spread his palms and cautiously touched his own hair.
"Leader! Your hair is falling out!"
"Leader, here's some sweet potato
croquette... with milk."
Ainas and Bubar finally blurted out something foolish. As Orgal quickly turned his head glaring at them, they reflexively raised their hands and tightly closed their eyes.
Orgal was again amazed by their reaction, considering he had never hit them.
Just as he was about to give in to the urge to beat them thoroughly, Orgal remembered the events of other worlds he had seen through the eyes of the black soldiers.
- "Leader! Ainas is… Ainas!"
- "Leader, don't make such a sad face, I sacrificed myself so we could break through, right? Finally, I can see Sister Bianca... don't give up!"
Surprisingly, in some worlds, this ridiculous duo had been comrades who fought together until the very end. In some instances, they had even outlived characters like Siron and continued to fight.

As far as Orgal knew, the world had been destroyed or fallen into Ziffle's hands at least hundreds of times. And that was a conservative estimate; it could be thousands, tens of thousands, or even millions. With so many battles, even Bubar and Bianca had their moments of glory.
Remembering this, he couldn't bring himself to hit them. Orgal unclenched his fist and sighed, then recalled his conversation with Helluram.
- Moreover… just as I made the Abyss Legion at your request, Ziffle has also created a massive army encompassing all dimensions.
- [What!?]
- The Demon Army, that’s what they call it. They move between dimensions, supporting Ziffle in each world.
- [That's insane, what the hell are you talking about?]
- Stop being surprised. You already know it, having experienced it.

She was right. At the end of every world Orgal had experienced, Kelliark had always mocked, saying, ‘The battle in this world is over.’ In any world, by that stage, the fact that there were multiple worlds was not a big secret.
- The Ziffle of this world has almost completed the Origin Stone. It has made a sudden and enormous leap in progress in the last few days. Thanks to help from the Demon Army."
The Demon Army.
Ziffle across all dimensions had already gained power surpassing the current Helluram. There was no reason they couldn't create a force like Helluram's Abyss Legion.
Ziffle was the only group that had conquered or destroyed most dimensions. The Ziffle of this world just hadn't reached that stage yet.

- [Ha! Haha! So while Ziffle bastards were causing all this chaos, what the hell have you been doing, Helluram? While all those worlds were closing and perishing, what did you do? Not just you, Solderet, and all those gods too! Did you just sit by and twiddle your thumbs as things got to this point?]

- Solderet had already lost his power at that time. I always thought it was due to our conflict, but perhaps this situation is also related to the Jin Runkandel. The other gods are just as you saw. Most became slaves of Ziffle. And I… always chose you.
Helluram had not been idle.
She had always been active in trying to stop Ziffle from the moment she became aware of the fact that 'there are multiple worlds'.
However, Ziffle of other worlds always checked Helluram, resulting in this vicious cycle. Helluram was always late in realizing the truth of the world.

She could only become aware of it after a certain point. Even that was possible only because she was Helluram; most other immortals couldn't discover this fact on their own, not even the avatars of the Sun God.
Orgal had already realized this through the soldier but had nothing else to say or do but to vent his anger at Helluram.
- Soon, the Demon Army will realize our meeting, Orgal.
- [...Yes, they will. Their completed Origin Stones will soon record this fact. At least, it's a relief that there are constraints on Ziffle's interference between dimensions.]

Neither Helluram nor Orgal knew exactly what those constraints were. Without them, all dimensions would have already fallen into Ziffle's hands. In that case, even the future of destruction would not have been an option.
Shaken by the chilling truth, Orgal trembled continuously. Meanwhile, he tried to regain his sanity little by little.
From now on, it was clear that he and Kinzelo had to fight against Ziffle.
Or they could choose a ‘comfortable’ life under Ziffle. Then, in the manipulated history, they could forget this heavy truth and live on.
But now, Orgal had not forgotten what he was, how he had fought. Just like all the
soldiers of the Abyss Legion.
- [Was my long-held dream to resurrect the Sun God and restore a perfect world all in vain? Haha... This is driving me crazy. All those worlds... and not once could I save them.]
Protagonist.

Undoubtedly, Orgal had been the protagonist in those numerous worlds where he either faced defeat or the world's destruction. He was the great hero recognized by everyone after overcoming many hardships and receiving the strongest blessing of the gods, but he could never avoid a tragic end.
Suddenly, Orgal looked at the soldiers of the Abyss Legion. He revisited the memories experienced by Orgals from other worlds.
Strangely enough.
There was a name that never appeared in any world, a person who was exerting a powerful influence in this world but was completely absent from any memory.

- [Jin Runkandel. In the history of all these worlds, he never appeared... These Orgals have allied with almost every force in those worlds, including Runkandel, Hairan, Ice Castle, traitors of Ziffle, avatars of the Sun God, and the true Demon Realm.]
Even Bubar and Ainas had their moments of being great heroes, becoming the hope of the world, but the great Jin Runkandel never acted in any world.
An unsettling feeling crept in. In some ways, it was even stranger than the truth of the world.
- Interesting, isn't it?

- [Is that all? How can Jin Runkandel not appear even once in all these stories? Even histories where Solderet chose him didn't exist. Naturally, there was no formation of the Barmel Alliance, and it was always our Kinzelo that led the coalition...]
- "As I said earlier, he is closely related to the reason Solderet lost his power. I don't know exactly what happened."
- [Then Solderet foresaw all this and invested everything in Jin Runkandel for a single opportunity at a very special moment. And that's this world. Can't we think like that?]
Helluram immediately shook her head at that suggestion.
- Solderet always chose Temar. Just as I still choose you. Moreover, the power he possessed is not greater than mine. I don’t think he would have known something before me.
Indeed, Solderet always chose Temar. The Thousand-Year Sword Demon War had been an event in every world.
But just once, in this world alone, he bestowed power upon Jin. At least according to the memories of the Abyss Legion.
- But if someone else had helped, they might have recognized the split worlds sooner.
- [Someone else’s help…?]
At that moment, Orgal realized another name that had never appeared in any world besides Jin Runkandel.
- [Valeria Hister... Are you talking about her?]
Valeria Hister.
Like Jin, she too had never acted in any world. Even in worlds where the 'Hister' family had not been completely erased.
Only those two had never fought alongside Orgal through the end of so many worlds.
Realizing this, his heart started racing.
Then Jin and Valeria were essentially secret weapons that no world of Ziffle had ever encountered. They were literally the biggest variables.
‘I’m losing strength. But Jin Runkandel and Valeria Hister... can I really trust those two?’
As Orgal organized his conversation with Helluram, he pulled his hair and punched his chest.
It wasn't a matter that could be immediately judged.
Because it couldn't be completely ruled out that Solderet might already be under Ziffle's influence.
[Based on what has been revealed so far… It doesn't seem likely. But if it's true, why would Ziffle use the two of them like this?]
“Leader? What are you talking about all of a sudden?”
The members didn't understand his sudden monologue. But Marjiella understood his words precisely.
She was the only one in Kinzelo who understood the truth as much as Orgal.
"Maybe they need those two to resurrect the Sun God, Leader. They might need the Sun God to further strengthen the Origin Stone or to integrate the split worlds, something like that."
"What is Marjiella talking about?"
"Ahaha, it’s not such an interesting story. Mr. Bubar."
Orgal nodded as if he had made a decision.
[…For now, I need to meet Jin Runkandel and talk to him. I will go meet him and Valeria Hister right now.]
Note: Demon Army - literal TL / could be Origin Army
